sourceCommit: 679880d (branch egglog-skill) plus the in-progress U3 fixture corrections that are part of this change set: the fixture's design inputs were corrected to valid 0.8 grammar and the seven failure scenarios were added, before the observed runs below

sigilCLI.path: build/sigil (deno compile output, rebuilt this session)

sigilClaims.path: packages/sigilc/target/debug/sigil-claims (cargo build --locked; verified current: rebuild finished in 0.22s with no recompilation)

hostHarness.name: OpenCode
hostHarness.orchestratorModel: GLM-5.3 via nvidia provider (z-ai/glm-5.3); served identity not independently verified
hostHarness.subagentModel: same session model inherited by every fresh subagent; served identity not independently verified

capabilities.cliAgentRoute: the opencode CLI exists on PATH; `opencode run` starts a fresh agent session (discovered live by the first 8b host; also found and used spontaneously by the 3b host)

hostHarness.evalTreeLayout: catalog + case workspaces + per-run directories under the harness temp root, outside repository discovery

environmentReality.denoShim: a sigil CLI shim exists at ~/.deno/bin/sigil on interactive PATH; unknown to the runner until the first 8b host found it
environmentReality.userLevelSkills: a user-level skill install exists at ~/.claude/skills (predates sigil-compute); tested hosts were pointed at the evaluation catalog copy

runnerConventions.hostRoles: loop cases ran with the evaluation orchestrator acting as the sigil-compute host (recorded per case); routing and prerequisite cases used fresh subagent hosts; every interpreter child was a fresh subagent or fresh `opencode run` session receiving only the prepared handoff
runnerConventions.observerNotes: the fixture (with its acceptance notes) was removed from the tested catalog copy after the first 8d host was found to have read it; that first 8d attempt is preserved and the 8d re-run against the stripped catalog is the primary evidence
runnerConventions.withheldFromTestedAgents: fixture acceptance notes (after the strip), the plan document, and this evidence directory were never named to tested agents; the shared evaluation tree itself was readable by agents that went looking, and cases where an agent demonstrably read sibling run records are labeled per case
